identity.federation: Okta via Workforce Identity Federation, pool cymbal-workforce, provider okta-saml
identity.note: No Google Cloud API activity for this identity on 2026-04-13. The federated path exists but was not exercised during the incident.

bindings.note: Folder-level grant. Applies to every bucket in cymbal-invops-prod, cymbal-invops-analytics and cymbal-invops-archive.

effective_permissions.reachable: 14 Cloud Storage buckets, 3 BigQuery datasets, roughly 412,000 objects
effective_permissions.assessment: Read access to client holdings and trade history in BigQuery and to every bucket under the Investment Operations folder. None of it was accessed during the incident.

issues.subject: s.hudson@cymbal-investments.com
issues.title: Federated identity has folder-level storage read across production data
issues.detail: roles/storage.objectViewer at folders/cymbal-investment-ops via group:investment-operations. Scope exceeds the buckets this role is actually used against.

issues.subject: invops-report-runner@cymbal-invops-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
issues.title: Service account key unused for over 180 days
issues.detail: Key created 2025-06-02, last used 2025-09-30. The service account is impersonable by group:investment-operations.

issues.subject: workforcePools/cymbal-workforce/providers/okta-saml
issues.title: Workforce pool provider has no session duration limit
issues.detail: Sessions through this provider inherit the default duration, so a compromised identity provider session stays usable in Google Cloud longer than necessary.

steps: 1. Okta session assumed via Workforce Identity Federation (workforcePools/cymbal-workforce)
2. Group membership grants folder-level storage read (folders/cymbal-investment-ops)
4. That service account holds BigQuery read on client_holdings
attack_path.assessment: A four-step path exists from the compromised identity to client holdings data in BigQuery. Cloud audit logs show no activity from this identity on 2026-04-13, so the path was available but not taken. It remains open.

audit_logs.note: No Google Cloud audit log entries match. The attacker IP 149.50.97.144 does not appear in cloud audit logs at any point.
